newsitem.title: UK: BG shares rise despite weaker market.
newsitem.headline: BG shares rise despite weaker market.

text.p: Shares in BG Plc bucked the generally weak market trend on Monday morning, trading 2-1/2 pence higher at 253.

Analysts and market-makers said there was no news in the market to explain the resilience of BG, which is trading close to its highest levels since demerger. BG touched a post-merger peak of 259 pence on Friday.
One market-maker said there was strong, broadly-based buying interest in the stock.
SocGen analyst John Toalster said "it seems surprising. It has seemed expensive for some time. We have got it on a hold, but not a very strong hold."

The stock was boosted on Friday, after Merrill Lynch raised its trading recommendation to "neutral" from "reduce", reflecting the prospect of greater rewards for shareholders and the end of uncertainty over the government's windfall utility tax.
There was some speculation that investors could be switching out of stocks such as banks and pharmaceuticals and into selective defensive issues like utilities.
Among other gainers in a sea of red on Monday were PowerGen Plc up 3-1/2 pence at 786-1/2 and National Power Plc.
